## Checklist

- [ ] Pages follow the shape in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#-writing-a-page) and have at least one diagram with a caption
- [ ] Breadcrumb, "On this page" list and footer are present
- [ ] New or moved pages are listed in the chapter README, `README.md` and `SUMMARY.md`
- [ ] All relative links and anchors work
- [ ] Code snippets run with the versions stated
- [ ] New terms are in [GLOSSARY.md](../GLOSSARY.md) and linked on first use
- [ ] Difficulty badge and reading time are set
- [ ] Facts are sourced; no copied text or images
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under CC BY 4.0 (content) and MIT (code)
